tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page and instrument ground under everything. An alias of the active material's ground; a material class on a subtree swaps it.

tokens.name: mercury-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the Mercury material (the default). Use ground in components, not this.

tokens.name: tube-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the Tube material: a warmer black by night, warm paper by day.

tokens.name: wire-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the Wire material: a colder black by night, cold porcelain by day.

tokens.name: plasma-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the Plasma material: a violet black by night, cool paper by day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Fill of dock controls and fields: a translucent plate, so a live canvas still reads through it.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque fill where translucency would show through: selects and their option lists.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button at rest (Speak): the one raised control in a dock — lighter than surface in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Opaque ground of an application panel, card, menu or dialog — the app surface the instrument sits beside. Text on it as on ground.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: A step above panel: hover rows, muted fills, a selected list item, the track of a switch.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px rule beside a telemetry heading. Decorative.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: The 1px floor under a sparkline. Decorative.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Between the segments of a segmented control. Decorative.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty meter tracks and unfilled buffer cells. Decorative: the accent fill carries the value.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Resting edge of labelled controls (buttons, toggles, the segmented group). Below 3:1 on purpose: the label identifies the control. Never the only edge of a field.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of text fields and selects, and of the primary button at rest: at least 3:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Any control edge under the pointer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Opaque hairline between application regions (sidebar, header, list rows) where a translucent hairline would stack.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Values, field text and settled transcript words, on ground, surface and surface-solid.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: The word being spoken now and the large live readout, on ground.

tokens.name: ink-quiet
tokens.usage: Unselected segment labels and neutral status words (Standby, Slewing), on ground, surface and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Telemetry labels, captions, placeholders and hints, on ground, surface and surface-solid.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The quietest words: timestamps, counts, helper lines. Still 4.5:1 on ground, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: The status dot at rest. A mark, not text: 3:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one live colour: focus ring, active control edge and label, meter and cell fills, the active status dot, notices. As text, on ground, surface and accent-tint. An alias of the active material's accent.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind accent text on an active control (Stop while speaking, the selected segment) and under sparkline bars.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 1px solid outline 2px outside the control (inset 3px inside a segmented group). At least 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a filled accent (a filled primary button): near-black on the night amber, white on the day amber.

tokens.name: info-dot
tokens.usage: Tone info: the dot and glyph of a neutral fact worth noticing.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tone info: the soft fill behind info-ink.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Tone info: words, on info-soft, ground and panel.

tokens.name: positive-dot
tokens.usage: Tone positive: done, passed, merged — the dot and glyph.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tone positive: the soft fill behind positive-ink.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Tone positive: words, on positive-soft, ground and panel.

tokens.name: warn-dot
tokens.usage: Tone warn (gold, never the live amber): waiting on you, a soft failure — the dot and glyph.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tone warn: the soft fill behind warn-ink.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Tone warn: words, on warn-soft, ground and panel.

tokens.name: danger-dot
tokens.usage: Tone danger: destructive or denied only — the dot and glyph.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tone danger: the soft fill behind danger-ink.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Tone danger: words, on danger-soft, ground and panel.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The one destructive fill (Delete), the same in both themes, always with on-danger words.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on the danger fill: 5.3:1.

tokens.name: mercury
tokens.usage: Accent of the Mercury material (default): the warm signal beside a chrome core.

tokens.name: mercury-tint
tokens.usage: Active fill for the Mercury material.

tokens.name: tube
tokens.usage: Accent of the Tube material: amber vacuum-tube glass, for slow, late, reflective sessions.

tokens.name: tube-tint
tokens.usage: Active fill for the Tube material.

tokens.name: wire
tokens.usage: Accent of the Wire material: razor cyan wireframe, for fast debugging.

tokens.name: plasma
tokens.usage: Accent of the Plasma material: a charge held in dark glass.

tokens.name: wire-tint
tokens.usage: Active fill for the Wire material.

tokens.name: plasma-tint
tokens.usage: Active fill for the Plasma material.

tokens.name: signal-a
tokens.usage: The lead phase-line ribbon and the middle armillary ring, the azimuth pointer and reticle. Graphics only, never text.

tokens.name: signal-b
tokens.usage: The second ribbon and the inner armillary ring. Graphics only.

tokens.name: signal-loop
tokens.usage: The breathing loop, the bezel ticks and the third ribbon. Graphics only.

tokens.name: signal-halo
tokens.usage: The glow around the core. Graphics only.

tokens.name: mercury-signal-a
tokens.usage: Mercury: lead ribbon (amber).

tokens.name: mercury-signal-b
tokens.usage: Mercury: second ribbon (ice).

tokens.name: mercury-signal-loop
tokens.usage: Mercury: the loop (white by night, graphite by day).

tokens.name: mercury-signal-halo
tokens.usage: Mercury: core halo.

tokens.name: tube-signal-a
tokens.usage: Tube: lead ribbon.

tokens.name: tube-signal-b
tokens.usage: Tube: second ribbon.

tokens.name: tube-signal-loop
tokens.usage: Tube: the loop.

tokens.name: tube-signal-halo
tokens.usage: Tube: core halo.

tokens.name: wire-signal-a
tokens.usage: Wire: lead ribbon.

tokens.name: plasma-signal-a
tokens.usage: Plasma: lead ribbon, and its filaments.

tokens.name: wire-signal-b
tokens.usage: Wire: second ribbon.

tokens.name: plasma-signal-b
tokens.usage: Plasma: second ribbon, and the rim of the glass.

tokens.name: wire-signal-loop
tokens.usage: Wire: the loop.

tokens.name: plasma-signal-loop
tokens.usage: Plasma: the loop.

tokens.name: wire-signal-halo
tokens.usage: Wire: core halo.

tokens.name: plasma-signal-halo
tokens.usage: Plasma: core halo.

tokens.name: mercury-mark
tokens.usage: The colour Mercury's body reads as: chrome. For a mark that says whose something is (a reply's loop). Mercury's accent is too near Tube's to tell them apart at that size.

tokens.name: tube-mark
tokens.usage: The colour Tube's body reads as: amber.

tokens.name: wire-mark
tokens.usage: The colour Wire's body reads as: cyan.

tokens.name: plasma-mark
tokens.usage: The colour Plasma's body reads as: violet.

tokens.name: chrome-highlight
tokens.usage: Chrome ramp 1/5, the specular hot spot. Graphics only; the ramp is the Mercury core's 2D fallback and the only gradient the system uses.

tokens.name: chrome-light
tokens.usage: Chrome ramp 2/5, the lit shoulder.

tokens.name: chrome-mid
tokens.usage: Chrome ramp 3/5, the body.

tokens.name: chrome-dark
tokens.usage: Chrome ramp 4/5, the reflected ground.

tokens.name: chrome-rim
tokens.usage: Chrome ramp 5/5, the rim light at the silhouette.

groups.name: Voice
groups.note: Geist, variable 100–900, for what the voice says and what you type to it. Weight is a live channel here: it follows the signal.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: a storm of high-dimensional vector math
styles.usage: The spoken line. The live word runs 300–780 with RMS; settled words keep their mean (300 + 460·mean^0.8); words not yet spoken sit at 250.

styles.name: field-text
styles.sample: Give it a line to speak…
styles.usage: Text typed into fields, and the one line a rim arrival says.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: The cases that were failing now pass, and two edge cases are still open.
styles.usage: What a session wrote, set to be read: Prose, and any markdown you render yourself under ast-prose. Headings, code and tables inside it are sized from it in em.

styles.name: said
styles.usage: Your exact words, quoted, wherever they anchor something: an action locked on your word, a ruling the companion keeps. A steady 380 — they were spoken, so they keep the weight of speech; nothing generated is ever set in it.

styles.name: row-text
styles.usage: The words on a folded ToolRow: the tool's name and what it acted on.

groups.name: Instrument
groups.note: Geist Mono, variable 100–900, for everything the instrument reports. Small, tracked, uppercase for labels; tabular by nature.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The one large live number in a panel (f0). Weight runs 200–520 with voicing.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A number among a few, in Prose's row of numbers. The one big number is still readout.

styles.name: telemetry
styles.usage: All panel text: labels (uppercase, ink-muted) and values (ink).

styles.name: telemetry-rule
styles.usage: Panel headings beside a hairline, uppercase.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Button, toggle and segment labels, uppercase.

styles.name: field-value
styles.usage: The value shown in a select.

styles.name: notice
styles.sample: Microphone blocked — allow it in the address bar.
styles.usage: One-line system notices, in accent, sentence case.

styles.name: caption-caps
styles.usage: A small uppercase label above content, in ink-muted.

styles.name: canvas-plate
styles.usage: Labels drawn on canvases (reticle, track and gauge plates), uppercase, on a ground plate at opacity-plate.

spacing.note: The instrument's own measurements, unsnapped. Small steps (1–6) live inside readouts; 8–18 inside and between controls; 24–40 place things in the viewport.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between sparkline bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buffer cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gap in a key-value list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Row gap between meters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dock gap; gap between blocks in a telemetry panel; dot-to-word gap in a status.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its hairline, an icon and its label, a meter's columns, inline readouts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Key-to-value column gap; title panel block gap; segment side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Text field side padding; gap between vector components.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Button side padding; the minimum viewport margin for the dock.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Primary button side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Telemetry inset from the top; dock inset from the bottom.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Telemetry inset from the left and right edges.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between the dock and the transcript or the lower panels.

radius.note: Machined, not soft: 2px on every control, square meters, true circles only for dots and discs. The instrument has nothing in between; an application adds two surface radii and no more.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Gauge cells and progress lines; a progress or quota meter in an application too.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Every control, field and group — and so every badge, chip, count, stepper and switch (whose knob is square too).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: In an application: cards, menus, popovers, toasts and message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: In an application: dialogs, sheets and panels docked over the work.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: True circles only: status dots, discs (a launcher, the instrument itself) and avatars.

shadow.note: Nothing at rest casts a shadow: things rest on hairlines. Only what floats over the app does, and each shadow carries its own hairline so it reads on either ground.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, a panel floating or docked over the work, a card being carried. The one floating shadow: nothing gets a deeper or softer one.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets over a scrim.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layout is built on.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of every dock control (also the minimum touch target).

tokens.name: size-segment
tokens.usage: Height of a segment inside its bordered group.

tokens.name: size-label
tokens.usage: Label column of a key-value list and of a labelled select.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot.

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: Buffer cell height.

tokens.name: size-glyph
tokens.usage: Filled glyphs (play, stop).

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Stroke icons (mic, upload) drawn on a 16px grid.

tokens.name: size-dock
tokens.usage: Dock maximum width.

tokens.name: size-core-rest
tokens.usage: The companion's core on its own, where a screen has no hoop round it: the one thing always on screen, and the way to call up anything that is not.

tokens.name: size-instrument-rest
tokens.usage: The instrument docked at the foot beside your work: the core in its hoop, small and still live.

tokens.name: size-instrument-near
tokens.usage: The instrument leaned in: the size it grows to when you reach for it while it is docked, so its hoop can be turned.

tokens.name: size-instrument-home
tokens.usage: The most the instrument grows to at home, when it has the center of the screen.

tokens.name: size-opening
tokens.usage: Width of an Opening: the plate that unfolds from a slot or mark when you click it.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Height of a folded ToolRow. Under a finger it is size-control.

stroke.note: Line weights. Everything structural is a hairline; only the loop and the ribbons thicken, and only with the voice.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, rings, ticks, control edges.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Stroke icons, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-reticle
tokens.usage: Reticle corners on the dial.

tokens.name: stroke-loop
tokens.usage: The loop at rest inside the full dial; it thickens with low and mid energy.

tokens.name: stroke-loop-solo
tokens.usage: The loop at rest when it is the whole display.

tokens.name: stroke-strand
tokens.usage: Lead ribbon line of the phase-lines.

opacity.note: Opacity encodes time: what is not yet said is faint, what was said is nearly full.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Transcript words not yet spoken (lookahead).

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: A readout with no live value (unvoiced f0), and disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-plate
tokens.usage: Ground plate behind canvas labels.

tokens.name: opacity-settled
tokens.usage: Transcript words already spoken.

duration.note: CSS timings. A thing arrives on a spring, lives on its signal, lingers a moment and settles. Signal motion inside canvases is springs and envelopes — see Motion in the brand book.

tokens.name: duration-tick
tokens.usage: Refresh interval for telemetry text; numbers update at this cadence, canvases every frame.

tokens.name: duration-weight
tokens.usage: Font-weight transition on a transcript word as it settles.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity transition as a word moves from ghost to spoken, and every arrival under reduced motion.

tokens.name: duration-preroll
tokens.usage: The default lookahead window between intent and first audio, which the dial spends sweeping and locking.

tokens.name: duration-lock
tokens.usage: An arrival, an opening unfolding, the instrument changing size, the reticle closing on a target: the lock spring run to rest, with ease-lock.

tokens.name: duration-lobe
tokens.usage: Something drawn out of the core or the stream (the companion's words, its footprint): the liquid spring run to rest, with ease-lobe.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: A departure: the thing shrinks back toward where it came from and is gone, with ease-settle.

tokens.name: duration-linger
tokens.usage: How long a thing stays still after it stops being true, so a glance can catch it, before it settles.

tokens.name: duration-hold
tokens.usage: How long a prepared action holds for your word before it dissolves on its own.

easing.note: The two springs of the instrument as CSS easings, sampled from the physics: lock (ω = 2π·2.2, ζ = 0.62) and lobe (ω = 2π·2.3, ζ = 0.36). Nothing else arrives on any other curve.

tokens.name: ease-lock
tokens.usage: Attention and arrival: a small overshoot, then it holds. With duration-lock.

tokens.name: ease-lobe
tokens.usage: Extrusion: swells past its size and wobbles once, like the liquid core. With duration-lobe. Only for what comes out of the companion.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Departure: leaves gently, then quickly. With duration-settle.
